pertypenum.title: Permit and Certificate Type
pertypenum.remarks: Identifier of the permit and certificate type. The combination of organization, site, and permit and certificate type must be unique. After you create and save a permit and certificate type record, you cannot change this value.

certexpdate.title: Certificate Expiry Date
certexpdate.remarks: The date and time when the certificate expires. You can change this value only when the status of the permit and certificate type record is Draft.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Description of the permit and certificate type. You can change this value only when the status of the permit and certificate type record is Draft.

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: Group that owns the permit and certificate type record. To change this value, use the Select Owner action.

reference.title: Reference
reference.remarks: A reference for the permit or certificate. You can change this value only when the status of the permit and certificate type record is Draft.

permitwork.title: Permit to Work
permitwork.remarks: Indicates whether the permit or certificate type applies to a permit to work.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site to which the permit and certificate site record applies. The default value is null. If you enter a value, the system populates the Organization field with the corresponding organization. If the permit and certificate type record applies to all sites, do not enter a value. After you create and save a permit and certificate type record, you cannot change this value.

isocert.title: Isolation Certificate
isocert.remarks: Indicates whether the permit or certificate type applies to an isolation certificate.

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: Owner of the permit and certificate type. To change this value, use the Select Owner action or the Take Ownership action.

summary.title: Summary
summary.remarks: A detailed description of the purpose of the permit or certificate. You can change this value only when the status of the permit and certificate type record is Draft.

accesspermit.title: Access Permit
accesspermit.remarks: Indicates whether the permit or certificate type applies to an access permit.

classstructureid.title: Classification
classstructureid.remarks: A classification of the permit and certificate type.

materialcert.title: Material Inspection
materialcert.remarks: Specifies whether the certificate is a material inspection certification. If this check box is selected, corresponding inventory items, purchase requisition line items, and purchase order line items must be inspected and documented on delivery. You can change this value when the status of the permit and certificate type record is Draft.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization to which the permit and certificate type record applies. The default value is null. If you specify a value in the Site field, the system populates this field with the corresponding organization. If the permit and certificate type record applies to all organizations, do not enter a value. After you create and save a permit and certificate type record, you cannot change this value.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The server date and time when the record was created or updated through the Change Status action. This field is read-only.

category.title: Category
category.remarks: The category of the permit or certificate type. Valid values are in the PLUSGPERTYPECAT synonym domain. You can change this value only when the status of the permit and certificate type record is Draft.

personalcert.title: Personal
personalcert.remarks: Specifies whether a certificate is a personal certification. If the check box is selected, the certificate is a personal certification, and it is associated with a person in the People application. The default value is False (check box is cleared). You can change this value only when the status of the record is Draft. You cannot delete the record if the certificate is related to a person in the People application (that is, if the Personal check box is selected). When searching on this field, use Y to indicate a selected check box, and N to specify a cleared check box.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the permit and certificate type record. Valid values are in the PLUSGPERTYPESTATUS synonym domain. The default status, when you create the record, is Draft. You can change the value only through the Change Status action.
